title: Acid Barrel
summary: Break or throw this barrel to spread Acid.

fields.Activation: Break by reducing it to 0 HP or throw as an Action.
fields.Surface: 20 ft radius. Creatures standing in Acid have −2 AC.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
